title: Kroger Shutting select e-commerce operations in Florida and other states.
summary: This morning Kroger announced that it will close fulfillment centers in Florida, Maryland, and Wisconsin at the beginning of January. This will include spoke locations that are supplied by the fulfillment centers ncluding the one here in Jacksonville and Tampa along with Groveland.submitted by/u/gamingiscool[link][comments]

title: As Injuries Pile Up, So Does The Tampa Bay Lightning’s Win Total
summary: The road has been wonderful to Jon Cooper’s team, which is 17-4-4 away from Tampa and has not lost in regulation since a 2-0 setback at Toronto on December 8.
